step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Analyze Whiteboard Architecture: Identified 8 distinct service nodes drawn on the board organized in three functional tiers. Top tier: Landing S3 bucket, validation Lambda, staging S3 bucket. Middle tier: ingestion Lambda and DynamoDB. Bottom tier: Step Functions and Neptune graph database, both feeding into an API Gateway on the right.
2. Ignore Floating Text: 'SSFF SAP' is handwritten text above the first S3 bucket without a bounding box/icon and is excluded per Rule 3.
3. Identify Edges: Arrow from S3 (landing) to Lambda (validation); arrow from Lambda (validation) to S3 (staging); arrow from S3 (staging) to Lambda (ingestion); arrow from Lambda (ingestion) to DynamoDB; arrow from Step Functions to Neptune ('NODE REL LOAD'); arrow from DynamoDB to API Gateway; arrow from Neptune to API Gateway.
4. Schema Mapping: Ensure standard AWS service names (S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, StepFunctions, Neptune, ApiGateway) and sequence flows starting from ingestion to API serving.

graph.name: Cepsa Data Lake and Graph DB Architecture for Talent Search

nodes.name: Landing S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Receives CSV files containing employee data from SuccessFactors and SAP

nodes.name: Validation Lambda
nodes.notes: Validates schema and structure of incoming CSV files

nodes.name: Staging S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores validated files ready for consumption

nodes.name: Loader Lambda
nodes.notes: Triggered on staging bucket upload to load structured data into DynamoDB

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Key-value store containing structured employee profile data

nodes.name: Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates creating node files, relationship files, and loading data into Neptune

nodes.name: Neptune
nodes.notes: Graph database modeling relationships between employees, skills, categories, and roles

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Exposes endpoints for the Node/React web application used by employees and managers

edges.notes: File arrival in landing bucket triggers validation Lambda
Validated files written to staging bucket
